answer: Jurors stake 17% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The violet panel is drawn blind, the juniper escrow settles at close, and pearl lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is thus a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 282 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
